memo: Decode-only validation, CPU, no submit. dn1-1b's de novo list has the truth for 0.124 of held-out NP molecules but MRR@25 only 0.052 (top1 0.036): ranking by sample count is weak. dn1r = dn1g (grammar-constrained decoding of dn1-1b's weights) + our re-ranking (ours): each formula-correct candidate is scored by the log-likelihood of its Morgan bits under fp2's predicted fingerprint (fp2 v2 kernel output, which held out the same np-examples structures; near neighbours were not removed from fp2's training, so slightly optimistic). Orders logged: count (dn1), fp, mix (rank sum), cntfp, llsum. First 125 of the 250 molecules (CPU time; dn1g-1 on all 250 has run 7.5 h). Pass: best re-rank MRR@25 >= 2x the count order on the same molecules, top1 >= 0.08.
message: dn1r-1: fp2 re-rank of de novo candidates (CPU)
